title: Field-adapted PPRV Whole Genome MinION Library Build
author: Emeli Torsson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pnxdmfn
materials: In thermocycler (heated lid at >75 °C) sett up the following protocol
Quantify 1 µl purified DNA using Qubit flourometer.
In thermocycler (heated lid at >75 °C) sett up the following protocol

steps.title: Extract total RNA
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from the sample using the preferred method (spin‑column or magnetic‑bead based extraction).

steps.title: Anneal random hexamers
steps.instruction: In a tube combine 1 µl random hexamers (50 ng/µl), 1 µl dNTP mix (10 mM), add the RNA up to 11 µl, then add DEPC‑treated water to a final volume of 13 µl. Mix, centrifuge briefly and heat for 5 min to anneal the primers.

steps.title: Set up reverse transcription
steps.instruction: Prepare a master mix containing 4 µl 5× SuperScript IV buffer, 1 µl DTT (100 mM), 1 µl RNase inhibitor, and 1 µl SuperScript IV Reverse Transcriptase. Mix, centrifuge, and add the 13 µl annealed RNA. Run the thermocycler: 23 °C 10 min, 55 °C 15 min, 80 °C 10 min. Place the tube on ice for 1 min.

steps.title: RNase H treatment
steps.instruction: Add 1 µl RNase H to each tube and incubate for 20 min (temperature not specified).

steps.title: End‑repair and dA‑tailing
steps.instruction: Set up the end‑repair/dA‑tailing reaction for each sample (components not listed in the source). Mix by pipetting up and down at least 10 times and centrifuge briefly to collect liquid.

steps.title: AMPure cleanup after end‑repair
steps.instruction: Add 30 µl AMPure/HighPrep beads to the end‑repair reaction, mix by flicking the tube, and place directly on ice for at least 30 seconds.

steps.title: Prepare primer pools
steps.instruction: Using the ZIBRA project primers (amplicon length 800 bp, 100 bp overlap), prepare two 10 µM primer pools: one containing even‑numbered primer pairs and one containing odd‑numbered primer pairs.

steps.title: Q5 PCR amplification
steps.instruction: In a PCR tube combine 5 µl 5× Q5 reaction buffer, 0.5 µl dNTP mix (10 mM), 0.25 µl Q5 DNA polymerase, the appropriate volume of primer pool 1 or 2 (10 µM, variable), and DEPC‑treated water to a total volume of 22.5 µl. Add 2.5 µl cDNA from the RNase H step (total 22.5 µl). Run the thermocycler: 98 °C 30 sec; then 2‑40 cycles of 98 °C 15 sec, 65 °C 5 min.

steps.title: AMPure bead cleanup of PCR
steps.instruction: Add AMPure/HighPrep beads at 1.8× the PCR volume (e.g., 50 µl PCR + 90 µl beads). Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times, incubate at room temperature for 3‑5 min, place on a magnetic rack for 5‑10 min, and discard the clear supernatant. Wash the beads twice with 200 µl freshly prepared 70 % ethanol (30 sec each), then air‑dry at room temperature for 10‑20 min until ethanol is completely evaporated. Elute DNA with 40 µl elution buffer (10 mM Tris‑Acetate pH 8.0 or nuclease‑free water), vortex or pipette to mix, place on magnetic rack, and collect the eluate.

steps.title: Dilute PCR amplicons
steps.instruction: Dilute the eluate to contain 0.12 pmol of 800 bp amplicon (≈60 ng) in a final volume of 25 µl nuclease‑free water. Incubate on a Hula mixer for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Second bead cleanup of diluted amplicons
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube, place on a magnetic rack and discard the supernatant. While on the rack add 200 µl 70 % ethanol, remove without disturbing the bead pellet; repeat once. Spin down the beads, keep on the magnetic rack, remove any residual ethanol, and air‑dry for 3‑5 min at room temperature. Resuspend the bead pellet in 15 µl nuclease‑free water, flick the tube to mix, incubate for 2 min at room temperature, then place on the magnetic rack and allow the beads to pellet.

steps.title: Quantify end‑prepped DNA
steps.instruction: Measure 1 µl of the eluate with a Qubit fluorometer; aim for 50‑70 % recovery of the input material.

steps.title: Prepare native barcodes
steps.instruction: Thaw native barcodes at room temperature, mix by pipetting, and keep on ice until use.

steps.title: AMPure cleanup after barcode ligation
steps.instruction: Add 20 µl AMPure/HighPrep beads to the barcode ligation reaction, mix by flicking, incubate 5 min at room temperature, place on a magnetic rack and discard the supernatant. Wash the beads twice with 200 µl 70 % ethanol, air‑dry for 3‑5 min at room temperature, then resuspend the pellet in 10 µl nuclease‑free water, flick to mix, and incubate 2 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Incubate end‑prep
steps.instruction: Incubate the barcode‑treated sample for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Load library onto flow cell (first load)
steps.instruction: Gently mix the prepared library by pipetting up and down, then load 75 µl of the library onto the MinION flow cell via the SpotON sample port dropwise (allow each drop to flow before adding the next). Replace the SpotON cover, close the priming port, and close the MinION lid.

steps.title: Post‑load AMPure cleanup
steps.instruction: Add 20 µl AMPure/HighPrep beads to the reaction and mix by flicking. If the sample volume was increased in the previous step, calculate beads at 0.4× the reaction volume. Place on a magnetic rack and discard the clear supernatant.

steps.title: SFB bead washes
steps.instruction: Add 250 µl S Fragment Buffer (SFB) to the bead pellet, flick to resuspend, place on a magnetic rack and discard the supernatant. Repeat the SFB wash once more, ensuring all SFB is removed; spin down and pipet out any remaining liquid if necessary.

steps.title: Final elution
steps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnetic rack, resuspend the bead pellet in 15 µl nuclease‑free water, flick to mix, and incubate for 10 min at room temperature. Place the tube on a magnetic rack, transfer the clear eluate to a new 1.5 ml LoBind tube, and store on ice.

steps.title: Mix library before loading
steps.instruction: Incubate the final library on a Hula mixer for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Quantify final library
steps.instruction: Measure 1 µl of the final library with a Qubit fluorometer; aim for >0.011 pmol per sample (≈5.5 ng for 800 bp amplicons).

steps.title: Thaw sequencing reagents
steps.instruction: Thaw Sequencing Buffer (SQB), Loading Beads (LB), Flush Tether (FLT), and Flush Buffer (FLB) at room temperature, then keep them on ice.

steps.title: Prepare priming mix
steps.instruction: Add 46 µl thawed FLT directly to the tube containing thawed and mixed FLB, pipette up and down to mix, flick the tube, spin down, and incubate the mixture for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Prime flow cell (first)
steps.instruction: Open the flow cell lid, rotate the priming‑port cover clockwise to expose the port, and check for small bubbles. Using a P1000 set to 200 µl, draw back 220‑230 µl of buffer to remove any bubbles. Load 800 µl of the priming mix (prepared above) into the flow cell via the priming port, then wait 5 min.

steps.title: Prime SpotON port
steps.instruction: Gently lift the SpotON sample‑port cover, then load 200 µl of priming mix into the flow cell via the priming port (not the SpotON port), avoiding introduction of air.

steps.title: Pool barcoded samples
steps.instruction: Pool each sample so that both primer pools (even and odd) for a given sample are combined in the same tube.

steps.title: Optional gel verification
steps.instruction: Run 3‑5 µl of each sample on a 1 % agarose gel at 6‑7 V/cm for 50‑60 min. Expected result: a clear band at the amplicon size (~800 bp) and possibly a second band at ~2400 bp (three‑fold size).
